name: @3eai-labs/ui-kit
description: 3eAI Labs Corporate UI Kit and Design System

scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp -r src/assets/. dist/assets/ && cp src/fonts/*.woff2 src/fonts/OFL.txt dist/fonts/ && node -e "const{interFontFaceCss}=require('./dist/fonts');require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/fonts/inter.css',interFontFaceCss('.')+'\n')"
